title: Method and headers

choices.md: Sending a body the other side must store
Asking to read — a body is not required

blocks.promptMd: `Content-Type` is a {{a}} on the message. If that header is missing, write {{b}}.
blocks.explainMd: Headers are labels. Missing content-type is not an error here — describe it as none.

blocks.promptMd: > `describe(req)` returns `` `${req.method} ${req.headers['content-type'] || 'none'}` ``. Print `describe` of a POST with `application/json`.

hintLadder.md: If that header is missing, use the word `none`.
Print a POST whose content-type is `application/json`.

description: A request has a method and labels. Those labels tell the other side how to read the body.
